mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia increase digoxin toxicity risk by reducing the activity of Na+/K+-ATPase and increasing myocardial irritability.
action: Monitor serum potassium and magnesium levels regularly; maintain potassium >3.5 mEq/L and magnesium >2 mg/dL; consider potassium-sparing agent or ACE inhibitor co-therapy; monitor digoxin levels and signs of toxicity.
